title: DNA Extraction from Magnaporthe oryzae (PCR quality)
author: Sophia Haeussler
materials: Steps 2-6 are performed in a sterile hood.

steps.title: Sterilize forceps and spatula
steps.instruction: Place forceps and a 5 mm‑wide spatula into ethanol, flame‑sterilize, then let cool.

steps.title: Prepare sterile liquid medium
steps.instruction: Pour 50 ml of sterile complete medium into a sterilized 100 ml Erlenmeyer flask.

steps.title: Start M. oryzae culture
steps.instruction: Place a filter‑paper stock onto complete‑medium agar and incubate for 7 days at 25 °C.

steps.title: Transfer agar plugs to broth
steps.instruction: Using sterilized forceps or spatula, move the agar plugs into the liquid complete medium.

steps.title: Incubate liquid culture
steps.instruction: Incubate on a rotary shaker at 25 °C, 120 rpm for 2 days; medium should stay transparent (milky indicates bacterial contamination).

steps.title: Filter and wash mycelium
steps.instruction: Filter the culture through two layers of Miracloth, then wash the retained mycelium with sterile MilliQ water.

steps.title: Dry mycelium
steps.instruction: Squeeze Miracloth to remove excess liquid; if liquid remains, place mycelium between two Watman filter papers and squeeze again.

steps.title: Pre‑cool equipment and grind
steps.instruction: Pre‑cool a mortar, pestle, small spatula and a 1.5 ml reaction tube in liquid nitrogen; place mycelium in the mortar, add liquid nitrogen, grind to a fine white powder, keeping material frozen (add more liquid nitrogen as needed).

steps.title: Collect ground powder
steps.instruction: Using the pre‑cooled spatula, transfer the powder into the precooled 1.5 ml tube up to the 100 µl mark, close the lid, freeze in liquid nitrogen, then proceed immediately or store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Add RNase A to buffer
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat a water bath to 60 °C; add RNase A (3 µl per 600 µl buffer) to the extraction buffer.

steps.title: Add extraction buffer and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl extraction buffer (containing RNase A) to each tube and vortex thoroughly.

steps.title: Heat lysate
steps.instruction: Place tubes in the 60 °C water bath for at least 10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 20 000 rcf for 1 min.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 400 µl of clear supernatant to a new 1.5 ml tube.

steps.title: Add ethanol and mix
steps.instruction: Add 400 µl (1× volume) of 96 % ethanol and mix by inverting 10 times.

steps.title: Load onto Econospin column
steps.instruction: Transfer the 800 µl mixture to an Econospin column (catalog 1920‑250, EpoChlifescience) or an AHN myTube SC 0.8 ml filter tube (GF‑F2 filter, 2 ml receiver).

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 20 000 rcf for 1 min and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 450 µl 70 % ethanol, centrifuge at 20 000 rcf for 1 min.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 350 µl 70 % ethanol, centrifuge at 20 000 rcf for 1 min; discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry column
steps.instruction: Place the column back in the collection tube and spin at 20 000 rcf for 2 min to remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Place the column into a new 1.5 ml tube, add 40 µl MilliQ water (optionally pre‑heated to 55 °C), incubate 1 min, then centrifuge at 20 000 rcf for 1 min. Pre‑heating water can increase yield.

steps.title: Cut agar plugs
steps.instruction: Using a sterilized spatula, cut 6–8 agar plugs (5 mm × 5 mm) from the colony’s outer edge (young vegetative hyphae).
